test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following forms a part of the State Executive as per the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Governor of State__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The executive head of the State government is the Governor.**
 
• State Executive consists of Governor and Council of Minister with Chief Minister as its head.
 
• The governors of the states of India have similar powers and functions at the state level as those of the President of India at central level.
 
• The governor appoints the Chief Minister, who enjoys the support of the majority in the State Legislative Assembly.

 Thus, we can say that** the executive head of the State Government is the Governor.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Governor comes in the Part-6 of the constitution of India from Article (152-162). It is the executive head of the states and its appointed by the President of India.
 
• Article (153) defines that there shall be Governor of each state and the same person to be appointed as Governor of two or more states.
 
• Article (154) defines the Executive power of the Governor that is related to Appointments, Administration, and Removals.
 
• Legislative Power defines that related to Lawmaking and the State Legislature, which is the State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) and State Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha).
 
• Discretionary Power defines that to be Carried Out According to the Discretion of the Governor of the state.
 
• Financial Power defines that related to the Annual Financial Statement which is the State Budget of any state.
